setting.location_specific: Agraharam street leading toward Kapaleeshwarar Temple tank, Mylapore, Chennai. Lime-washed red-and-white striped masonry wall (Thiruman-Srichurnam pattern) damp at the base.
setting.time_and_season: 5:15 AM, mid-Margazhi month (December). Misty, cool dawn air before traffic begins.
setting.ambient_lighting: Single warm sodium-vapor streetlamp overhead casting long shadows, softly blending with the indigo pre-dawn natural skylight.
environmental_details: Lightly swept wet asphalt with damp granite curb stones
Faint haze of morning steam from a nearby brass vessel
Fine wet rice-flour slurry (Arisi Maavu) dipping off fingers

subject.character: A 55-year-old woman wearing a muted indigo Thirupuvanam silk sari with a thin gold zari border, tucked tightly at the waist for work. Silver toe rings (Mettti) and simple glass bangles.
subject.action: Bending low to draw a geometric chikku kolam with wet rice paste. Her hand moves fluidly, fingers dropping precise white dots across the granite step threshold without hesitation.

cinematography.camera_movement: Slow low-angle tracking shot, drifting horizontally parallel to the ground as her hand traces the line, coming to a gentle rest on her face in profile.
cinematography.framing_and_lens: 50mm prime, f/1.8 shallow depth of field; crisp focus on the wet white paste adhering to the dark road before pulling focus to her calm, focused eyes.
cinematography.color_palette: Deep indigo, warm sodium amber, slate gray, muted crimson, crisp chalk white.

diegetic_sounds: Soft scraping of a palm against swept granite
Distant, muffled Nadaswaram practice scale echoing from three streets over
Single quiet splash of water from a brass chembu onto stone
audio_cues.ambient_score: Minimalist Tanpura drone quietly humming under the environmental acoustics.
